hero.text: A bilingual consulting firm dedicated to building organizational capacity and removing barriers to success since November 2018

companyOverview.heading: Our Story & Mission
companyOverview.text: Knowledge Without Borders / Connaissance Sans Frontières was incorporated in November 2018 with a clear vision: to provide comprehensive capacity-building services that empower organizations to achieve their full potential.
companyOverview.text2: As a bilingual firm, we bridge language and cultural barriers, ensuring that organizations across diverse communities have access to high-quality consulting services. Our approach combines academic rigor with practical experience, delivering solutions that are both theoretically sound and practically applicable.
companyOverview.text3: We believe that knowledge should be accessible to all, regardless of organizational size, budget constraints, or geographical location. This philosophy drives our commitment to providing flexible, culturally sensitive, and cost-effective consulting solutions.
companyOverview.text4: To provide capacity-building services that strengthen organizations and empower communities to achieve sustainable growth and meaningful impact.
companyOverview.text5: A world where organizational excellence is achievable for all, creating stronger communities and lasting positive change.

leadershipSection.heading: Leadership & Expertise
leadershipSection.text: Led by experienced professionals with deep expertise across multiple disciplines
leadershipSection.text4: Dr. François Yabit is a multidisciplinary and poly-experienced professional who brings extensive expertise in organizational development, strategic planning, and capacity building. His academic credentials combined with practical experience make him uniquely qualified to lead complex organizational transformation initiatives.
leadershipSection.label: PhD in Organizational Development
leadershipSection.text5: Our leadership combines rigorous academic training with practical field experience, ensuring evidence-based solutions that deliver measurable results.
leadershipSection.text6: We collaborate with academics and professionals across our 8 consulting areas, expanding our expertise when needed for specialized projects.
leadershipSection.text7: Native fluency in both English and French enables us to serve diverse communities and facilitate cross-cultural organizational development.
